notes.title: Madnight 2025 Has Ended – Now the Hellish wait begins!
notes.content:
[b]The World of Agony[/b] is growing! 

Dear fans! We are pleased to announce that our universe, connecting all the games we produce, is growing even more, thanks to the Tormentor, in which you will find a lot of references to Agony, [b]Succubus[/b] or Paranoid. 

But that's not all. During Madnight 2025, we answered your questions about Sirens, Lust of God, Agony: Lords of Hell and we revealed many details about these productions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/0936d867be95b03d0ed6aec5c258f768ff28f8ff.jpg[/img]


Madnight 2025 is over, and what a night it was. 59 minutes of pure, unfiltered horror, a deep dive into Tormentor, a fight against censorship, and surprises that left our audience speechless. But this is just the beginning.

Now, Tormentor is officially on [b]Kickstarter[/b]. If you want this game to be as brutal, raw, and uncompromising as we envision, we need your support.

👉 [i][b]Follow and Back Tormentor, now on Kickstarter:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


[h2]Madnight 2025 – The Highlights[/h2]

🔴 [b]A Night of Madness[/b]
We kicked things off with a live-action sequence starring the Madmind himself, Tomek, who delivered a bone-chilling manifesto on the struggles of bringing this art form to you, the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/e9f573d0b625eafe34e9ba97e1b2da6762cbcee4.jpg[/img]You can watch it here: [url=https://youtu.be/cNs-Bfbd9CE?t=93][b]1:34[/b][/url]


🩸 [b]Tormentor Gameplay Demo & Deep Dive[/b]
For the first time, we gave a full gameplay walkthrough, exploring the main hub, showcasing mechanics, and revealing just how deep the depravity goes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cNs-Bfbd9CE&t=628

🎥 [b]Developer Interviews[/b]
The masterminds behind Tormentor joined us for exclusive interviews, revealing details and their vision for the many aspects of gameplay in Tormentor.

🔪 [b]Surprise Reveals & Teasers[/b]
We unveiled the Equinox Club update for Nymphomaniac and dropped a teaser for a mysterious new character, sending shockwaves through our community on Discord.

[h3]⚡ The Biggest Premiere in Our History[/h3]
To close the night, we made our biggest announcement yet, something that will shape the future of our studio. If you missed it, you’ll want to go back and watch it.

[previewyoutube=fdBuOCfpI5E;full]https://youtu.be/fdBuOCfpI5E[/previewyoutube]

[b]🤝 Now, It’s Your Turn – Support Tormentor[/b]

Madnight 2025 may be over, but the real fight begins now. We’re pushing boundaries, standing against censorship, and creating something truly uncompromising. If you want Tormentor to reach its full potential, we need your support on Kickstarter.

🔥[i][b] Follow and Back Tormentor when the Kickstarter launches:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


Thank you to everyone who joined us for Madnight 2025. Now, let’s bring this nightmare to life.

[b]Wishlist Tormentor and Join the Community server![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493440/TORMENTOR/

notes.title: The first look at Sanctus
notes.content:
Hello Martyrs!

Take a peak at our new game that we're creating in cooperation with writer Jacek Piekara and actress Matylda Damięcka!

[previewyoutube=UGCrIgGSrfc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Sanctus[/b] is a third-person perspective (TPP) horror game with erotic elements that will allow players to play the role of a young woman - Anna, who, in search of God, decides to join a Polish convent isolated from the world.

Unfortunately, the heroine quickly discovered that the order hides terrifying secrets. Visiting inquisitors and monks use their position to humiliate, torture and rape young nuns in order, they claim, to exorcise their sins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/2e7b5852aef866c0a1d83e61e91d6a484119b187.jpg[/img]

One of the most popular Polish writers of recent years - [b]Jacek Piekara[/b], the author of the best-selling series "Ja, Inkwizytor", is responsible for the script and dialogues in the game.

The role of main character of the game will be played by a well-known Polish actress and artist - [b]Matylda Damięcka[/b], who will lend the image and voice of the main character of the game - Anna.

Sanctus will use the mechanics of the combat and stealth system prepared during the development of [b]Tormentor.[/b] Both titles are created in the Unreal Engine 5 environment, ensuring a high level of audiovisual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/37e6207a2e00f05b316ed882a1f18bb059bbec4b.jpg[/img]

[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Stealth and execution system
[*] Extensive dialogue system
[*] interactions with items and mini-games
[*] Combat system based on melee weapons
[*] Solving riddles and puzzles 
[/list]

Learn more at this year's edition of the event organized by Madmind: [b]MADNIGHT 2023: Horror Showcase
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/f42a2ead2f0d0fe36d13d31f90dbd27136d4a575.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846570/Sanctus/

notes.title: Succubus Autumn Update
MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players[/b],

We would like to invite you to the video presentation organized together with Rely On Horror - "MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase", during which new materials from the widely understood horror games produced by Madmind Studio will be presented, with guest participation of developers from other studios.

MADNIGHT 2021: The Horror Showcase takes place [b]December 16, 2021[/b].

The entire event will be available at [url=www.relyonhorror.com]www.relyonhorror.com[/url] - one of the largest, most popular websites focused on horror games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/d92e8046f12eb649c01404242936cde9a3529667.jpg[/img]

MADNIGHT 2021 is [b]an event unprecedented in the gaming industry[/b], during which players will be able to get to meet the Hell Messenger for the first time - a mysterious creature with which they have been interacting for many months on our social media and Madmind Studio's Discord channel.

[b]The Hell Messenger[/b] will take viewers into a terrifying world of horror that can take many forms. Have you ever wondered what working in a crematorium looks like? What does a person with advanced paranoid schizophrenia feel and see? Or maybe you want an extreme dose of uncompromising brutality and gore? You will see all these and many other attractions soon during MADNIGHT 2021!

[b]MADNIGHT 2021 Horror Showcase will feature[/b]:

- Madmind Studio
- Black Rat
- Live Motion Games
- Lunarium Creations
- IGNIBIT
- Woodland Games

Over the past five years, Madmind Studio has become synonymous with frightening, controversial and violent games. This year's premiere of the studio's latest game, Succubus, [b]was very well received by players and critics[/b] who decided to give the game very positive recommendations.

In addition to good grades, [b]Succubus achieved great financial results[/b]. Released on October 5 2021, the game has so far made more money on Steam than the studio's previous game, Agony, in more than three years since its release.

“Succubus, announced back in 2018, after almost three full years of production, has finally been released. We wanted the game to be able to defend itself with the quality of workmanship and an original, previously unheard of in video games, dose of uncensored brutality on the day of its premiere. We are looking forward to the premiere of the first Succubus DLC, which will be released during MADNIGHT 2021 ”- [b]Madmind Studio[/b].

See you soon!
 
[url=www.relyonhorror.com]www.relyonhorror.com[/url]
[url=www.madmind-studio.com]www.madmind-studio.com[/url]

notes.title: Cherubi comes to Agony UNRATED!
notes.content:
[b]Hell(o) Martyrs,[/b]

Madmind Studio is thrilled to present [b]the newest teaser for SUCCUBUS[/b], showing [b]a new type of enemy[/b]. It is a spin-off to our first production - Agony, in which the main character became our beloved Succubus, named Vydija. Later this year, players will be able to watch and test the first gameplay from our new game!

[previewyoutube=9EskTCXk7K4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Cherub in Agony UNRATED[/h1]

Today, we published [b]a free update to the Agony UNRATED available on Steam.[/b] After downloading the new content, players will be able to come across a new demon species - [b]Cherub[/b] - in many places during the game. Although in [b]SUCCUBUS[/b] he will act as the opponent, players can now take a closer look at this demon, finding him in the [b]story mode of [/b][b]Agony UNRATED[/b]! At the same time, we would like to point out that we do not rule out enriching the content of our already released games with further free updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775390/4c13e66f2039505bb339193f0e36fb80fce07883.png[/img]

[h1]Cherub Characteristic[/h1]

Cherub is a demon who, like the iconic Onoskelis, can wield fire. Using pyrokinesis, he tries to keep the right distance from the player to minimize the risk of direct contact, which usually ends fast and brutal.
Cherub is not a character who prefers an honorable duel, which is why he usually appears in numerous groups, trying to encircle his victim.

[h1]Lore[/h1]

Cherub is a type of demon that was born of sin, while various species of infernal creatures began to interbreed with each other. The deformed body of this creature often moves in contradictory logic, giving the impression that each of the two demons joined together lives according to their own rules. His survival often depends on more powerful demons who live in correlation with him, benefiting from each other. When the characteristic scream of Onoskelis resounds in hell, it is the Cherub who is the first to arrive, helping in the fight and hoping for the possibility of eating warm corpses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775390/76f44f1a2601ef68a66652b69a1768a62f07ea1a.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

This type of demon usually attacks his victims when outnumbering them. He tries to circle the character and set it on fire with long-range fireballs. He often responds to the call of more powerful beings, arriving at the indicated place and supporting a larger demon in the fight. Only by killing the demon that summons Cherubs, you can stop the next ones from incoming.
Solo Cherub is an easy-to-kill character, so he tries to engage in combat only when the player is in a duel with stronger opponents.
 
[h1]Tactics[/h1]
 
- Start the elimination with a demon that summons Cherubs
- Always be on the move and use dodges to bypass ranged attacks quickly
- Use environmental traps to hurt many Cherubs at once
- Deflect attacks by pairing them at the right time
- Use magic and long-range attacks
- Use alternative weapon attacks and nail cherubs to walls and ceilings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775390/222553dda388d7224bd77db6a12bec3d7288367d.jpg[/img]

[b]Have fun,[/b]
[i]Madmind Studio Team[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/985830/SUCCUBUS/

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]The Hell Messenger[/i]

notes.title: Future of Agony on consoles!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33775390/6f6622cdbc16227aede9c8d812c9c6957d6bbea0.gif[/img]
[b]Hell(o) Martyrs,[/b]

We are pleased to announce that we have just started working on the next patch for the basic version of [b]Agony for PS4 and Xbox One consoles![/b]

The patch will contain many improvements and introduce new features known from the [b]UNRATED[/b] version of the game. Some of them are:
[list]
[*]traps
[*]level design improvements (new paths, changed item locations etc.)
[*]new lighting system
[*]new skill tree
[*]a new martyr model and some texture improvements 
[*]mini-map and a full map
[*]new ending for Succubus 
[*]Succubus mode and Agony mode available from the start
[*]a new setting and boss fight for Agony Mode
[*]improvements in the main menu and the pop-up menu
[/list]

[b]PLEASE NOTE[/b]: This patch will not introduce the uncensored scenes available in Agony UNRATED. [b]Agony on consoles will remain a PEGI 18+[/b] game but will be enriched with numerous improvements affecting gameplay and visuals.

The long time we need to perform this patch is caused by the fact that [b]Agony UNRATED[/b] contains many changes from the original, and the reconstruction and optimization of the console version will require many weeks of tests and patches. We must ensure that the game progress and trophies/achievements you have already won will not disappear with the new patch.

The[b] UNRATED[/b] version of the game was not prepared with consoles in mind, which is why developing the new console patch means large amounts of work and time. And we will do it. We want to do it for you because we actually care.

[b]Thank You for Your support and patience,[/b]
[i]Madmind Studio[/i]

notes.title: Agony UNRATED will make its debut this Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33775390/9c5b52e9273e7889884522ced2c3f1fbb0fa6784.jpg[/img]
[b]Hell(o) Martyrs,[/b]

[b]Madmind Studio[/b] would like to inform you that today we have finished work on the uncensored version of [b]Agony[/b].
[b]Agony UNRATED[/b] will make its debut this [b]Halloween, 31th October[/b].

We are aware that the premiere of our first game was disappointing for many players, as numerous technical errors and censored content effectively distracted from the game.
We would like to apologize for the mistakes we made and to compensate players for a long time waiting for the [b]UNRATED[/b] version, making it available at a significantly lower price.

[b]Agony UNRATED will be released on the STEAM platform, at the price of 14.99$/14.99€/49.99PLN.[/b]
Players who already have regular [b]Agony[/b] in their [b]Steam library[/b] will receive a [b]90% discount[/b] on the [b]UNRATED[/b] version.
[b]Agony UNRATED[/b] will be made available for [b]free on 29th October for all Agony Kickstarter backers[/b].

[h1]Agony UNRATED Trailer:[/h1]
https://youtu.be/euwq7ihPHI4

[h1]Agony UNRATED - changes from the basic version:[/h1]
[list][*]Improved quality of character models and textures,
[*]New types of threats - Traps,
[*]New types of environmental threats,
[*]New types of static opponents,
[*]A new, more extensive and useful character development system,
[*]Volumetric lighting,
[*]Normal Mode and Hard Mode with more opponents and puzzles,
[*]Completely new type of environment - the Forest, added to the procedurally generated Agony Mode, which now also includes additional traps and boss fights,
[*]8 different endings in the Story Mode,
[*]Possibility to follow the story mode as a Sukkub,
[*]Sukkub Mode and Agony Mode are unlocked at the first start of the game,
[*]Many new, uncensored scenes,
[*]Black and red image filter, inspired by the Agony trailers,
[*]World map and minimap,
[*]The possibility of setting up a fire and killing some opponents as a martyr,
[*]Sacrificial altars,
[*]New and modified paths for the player,
[*]Numerous technical improvements to the basic version of the game and much more.[/list]

[h1]Legal statement[/h1] 
Unfortunately, but the contracts we have in force, both publishing and rating, blocked us from releasing the patch and removing the censorship from the game. Any lawsuit related to the violation of these rules would most likely lead to the closure of our studio.
 
To release Agony Unrated, we had to choose an alternative route and remain in the shadows by announcing the suspension of our work on the game. Today, after a few months since the release of Agony, the deadline for contracts binding us has passed and we can share these details with you.
 
At the moment, the PC is the only platform that gives us the freedom to create the world we've come up with. This, unfortunately, means Agony Unrated can never appear as a Digital Edition on consoles.
If players and reviewers positively receive Agony Unrated, we will try to get a contract with the publisher who will agree to issue a limited number of copies of the boxed game, both on PS4 and Xbox One.
The release of the game in a box version is the only option for the production with the "Adult Only" age rating to appear on consoles.

[h1]Agony: Nintendo Switch[/h1]
We would like to inform that thanks to establishing cooperation with our colleagues from Ultimate Games, Agony will also be released in the Nintendo Switch version. The premiere is planned for the end of 2018.
 
[h1]About Agony UNRATED[/h1]
Agony Unrated features a full-fledged story mode as well as an open challenge system that randomly generates levels for players to explore and survive to gain new Highscores. Agony throws players in the midst of hell where they strive to stay alive and solve the riddle behind the mysterious Red Goddess; architect of this place of sorrow and pain, and the sole entity with knowledge of how escape… but there is more to the story than it seems. Haunted by nightmare creatures, players gain the ability to possess demons and other souls to find their way out of hell.
 
[h1]About Madmind Studio[/h1]
Madmind Studio is a game development studio created in 2016 by Tomasz Dutkiewicz. We are the team of game developers who are working for more than ten years in the video gaming industry. Our studio comprises veteran game developers, who have worked on numerous AAA titles, such as Witcher 3, The Division, Sniper: GW2, Alien Rage, Enemy front and more. The invaluable experience we have gained with these titles allows us to use this knowledge not only to translate it into high-quality titles but also to help and train new, passionate people who are just beginning their adventure with the gaming industry. At first, our studio only had nine people. The dynamic development of the company has allowed us to increase the number of employees. Currently, we have 23 employees employed. We are determined to create the best possible, visually stunning games with a unique atmosphere.

[b]See you in Hell,[/b]
[i]The Hell Messenger[/i]
